subject: maths
question:
Study the given pie-chart and answer the question that follows. The pie-chart shows the expenditure by a family on different heads.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8f2c1870b2f232afa4ec4531176f9a71ee5b2f4e721cafc71e7306f755712c6.png] 

The angle formed by the sector representing education at the centre of the circle is:
solution:
**Given:**

Expenditure of family in education = 15%

Expenditure of family on housing = 15%

Expenditure of family on clothing = 5%

Expenditure of family on food = 45%

Expenditure of family in entertainment = 10% 

Expenditure of family in miscellaneous = 10%

**Concept used:**

The complete angle of a circle is 360o.

**Calculation:**

As the angle of a circle = 360o

Thus, 

The angle formed by the sector representing education at the center of the circle is = 15% of 360o

⇒ (15)/(100) x 360o

⇒ 54o

∴ **The angle formed by the sector representing education at the centre of the circle is 54o.**
